''Elite Dangerous Field Manual'' ('''EDFM''') is an unofficial, community-created resource for ''Elite Dangerous''. EDFM is not affiliated with, operated by, sponsored by, or endorsed by Frontier Developments plc.

''Elite Dangerous'', Frontier Developments, and related game names, trademarks, artwork, imagery, and other intellectual property belong to Frontier Developments plc and/or their respective rights holders. Frontier game media used on EDFM is used in accordance with Frontier's published rules and any other permission applicable to the project.

{{EDFM policy commitments}}

== No endorsement implied ==
Nothing on EDFM should be interpreted as stating or implying that Frontier Developments plc has reviewed, approved, endorsed, sponsored, or is responsible for EDFM or its content.

Any authorization granted to EDFM for particular services or integrations does not constitute endorsement of the project as a whole unless Frontier expressly states otherwise.

== Trademarks ==
''Elite'', ''Elite Dangerous'', ''Frontier'', Frontier Developments, and related names, logos, and marks are trademarks or registered trademarks of Frontier Developments plc and/or their respective owners.

EDFM uses game and company names only as necessary to identify and discuss the products, services, features, and subject matter documented by the site. Such use does not imply ownership, affiliation, sponsorship, or endorsement.

EDFM does not claim ownership of Frontier's trademarks or other intellectual property.

== Frontier game assets and imagery ==
Screenshots, in-game imagery, game artwork, interface elements, and other material originating from ''Elite Dangerous'' remain the intellectual property of Frontier Developments plc and/or the applicable rights holder.

EDFM currently operates as a non-commercial community project and uses Frontier game media in accordance with Frontier's published [https://customersupport.frontier.co.uk/hc/en-us/articles/4404292442642-How-can-I-use-Elite-Dangerous-media Elite Dangerous Media Usage Rules].

Frontier's permission relating to its game content is separate from EDFM's own content license. Frontier-owned material is '''not''' relicensed under Creative Commons merely because it appears on an EDFM page.

EDFM does not use Frontier's official corporate logo or proprietary fonts as EDFM branding.

Where screenshots are used, EDFM's policy is to use captures supplied or created for EDFM rather than copying images from unrelated community websites, except where reuse is separately authorized by the applicable license or rights holder. See [[Elite Dangerous Field Manual:Screenshot Policy]].

== Commercial status ==
EDFM is currently a non-commercial project.

Frontier's published media usage rules state that advance permission is required for use of Frontier game content in promotional or commercial ventures, including commercial websites.

If EDFM's commercial status changes in the future, its use of Frontier-owned material will be subject to any additional permission or requirements provided by Frontier.

== Third-party sources and research ==
EDFM may consult and cite Frontier documentation, community resources, other wikis, databases, guides, forums, and other third-party sources as part of its research process.

Consulting a source does not make that source's content part of EDFM's license.

Contributors should write original EDFM text based on the underlying facts and research rather than copying third-party prose. Material from another source may only be reproduced when its license, the rights holder's permission, or applicable law permits that use, and any required attribution or other conditions must be followed.

This includes the ''Elite Dangerous'' Fandom wiki: it may be used as a research source and cited where appropriate, but EDFM does not treat its text or imagery as material that may simply be copied into EDFM.

== No transfer of third-party rights ==
Nothing in EDFM's Creative Commons license, contributor terms, or other site policies grants permission to reuse intellectual property belonging to Frontier Developments plc or any other third party.

Anyone reusing EDFM material is responsible for determining which elements are covered by CC BY-SA 4.0 and which elements require separate permission or reliance on an applicable legal exception.
